intro.text: A darkeyed seamstress of the second nahn living in Kholinar.

items.text: Muri had fled the occupation of Revolar for Kholinar, losing her thriving seamstress business. During the siege she struggled to feed her three daughters, even searching ditches for dead rats and cremlings.

Veil gave food to Muri and other refugees, but the Grips gang preyed on those she helped. When Muri overheard her name in a quarrel between Grips, she packed to flee with her family, and angrily told Veil she should have died instead of Grund.

personality.text: Usually thought of as nice and pleasant, with amusing gossip.
